coder_notes: Single registered intervention bundles three drugs; split into one row per moiety. Bevacizumab and temozolomide are established GBM therapies given as the backbone in the only arm; sintilimab is the investigational agent (title frames sintilimab 'in combination with' bevacizumab and temozolomide), so bevacizumab/temozolomide coded soc_backbone rather than candidates. Inclusion 1 allows WHO 2016 grade III or IV high-grade glioma, but inclusion 3 and the conditions restrict to glioblastoma, so gbm_only; WHO 2016 cited -> historical. Target engagement coded yes on the immune-cell-subtype change outcome (pharmacodynamic for the anti-PD-1), though the sample (blood vs tumour) and link to sintilimab are not explicitly stated.
